abilities.name: Navigate
abilities.function: Travel toward a self-chosen coordinate or known object/item using observed obstacles.
abilities.costs: Actual distance times 2, increased by carried mass; speed 0.8 per simulation time unit.
abilities.effects: Continues until within the target interaction area or a real failure. Empty target uses x/y. A resource:ID target selects only a remembered ground stack.

abilities.costs: The interface-specific number of simulation rounds.

abilities.name: Request a capability
abilities.function: Describe an encountered problem, desired effect and known conditions for functional review.
abilities.costs: A game round to begin study after review; implementation time does not advance simulation.
abilities.effects: World review reuses equivalents or returns a structured development request. No request, learning or descriptive reward. Unknown methods and costs are allowed; the reviewer supplies a minimal feasible specification.

abilities.name: probe
abilities.function: Observe a nearby subject or physically test a small owned material sample.
abilities.costs: One round; actual observation or communication effort 0.2, physical trials 0.5 energy and 0.1 actual material unit.
abilities.effects: Only measured facts and performed interactions take effect. No mature capability or mastery is supplied.

abilities.name: name
abilities.function: Give a name of up to 60 characters to this place (empty subject) or to a visible object or nearby item; naming the same subject again replaces your name for it.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent name sign where you stand that nearby people can see. No physical effect.

abilities.name: mark
abilities.function: Leave a mark or inscription of up to 120 characters on the ground here (empty subject) or on an object or item within reach.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Leaves a persistent mark sign where you stand that nearby people can see; your 24 most recent names and marks persist. No physical effect.

abilities.name: tell
abilities.function: Say up to 240 characters aloud; everyone living within 5 units hears it, seen or not.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Each listener receives a heard event and keeps it in a short heard list. Nothing persists at the place. No physical effect.

abilities.name: invite
abilities.function: Invite listeners to meet at a place and a later round within 200 rounds, with an optional note of up to 120 characters.
abilities.costs: One round; no energy or material.
abilities.effects: Heard like tell, and leaves an invitation sign where you stand until 10 rounds after the meeting. At that round an attendance event records who is within 2.5 units of the place. No physical effect.

satisfaction.name: Confirmed understanding
satisfaction.rationale: A real experiment confirmed new information; repeated facts do not qualify.

satisfaction.name: Participating in an evidence exchange
satisfaction.rationale: Separate offer and acceptance around an actual finding; no relation or physical agreement is invented.
